A tartan kirtle, reaching below the knees, with trews of the same material, and a Highland bopnet, adorned with a tuft of eagle feathers, gave him the appearance of a Scottish youth ; but the sparkling black eyes, the clear brunette complexion, and the jetty locks which clustered around his brow and neck, proclaimed him the native of a warmer and brighter climate.
